mission: Help parents make realistic family-trip decisions through trustworthy destination tools and evidence-aware planning guidance.

full_day.activation: fresh explicit user request for a dated window; never credits, generic encouragement or heartbeat authority alone
full_day.default_window: request's actual America/New_York calendar day, ending at next local midnight; global cycle cutoff always earlier when applicable
full_day.daily_cap_override: only within the explicitly registered window, no shipping quota
full_day.restoration: exact captured normal baseline on first expired-window wakeup or explicit early-stop request; verify then return without project work
full_day.unconfirmed_restoration: no project work, report narrow scheduler dependency

temporary_continuous_work.daily_cap_override: October3 only; no two-action limit during this explicitly requested date-bounded sprint, no publishing quota

restoration.when: first actual wakeup on or after October4Eastern and before cycle cutoff
restoration.name: Family Tripwise - Two-Month Autopilot
restoration.normal_prompt_source: Unchanged suffix of ops/autopilot-prompt.md after Normal Cycle Instructions; equals saved recurring baseline and Git3edac7c
restoration.verification: Read saved automation metadata and exact normal prompt; require original identity/name/thread/status/cadence/cutoff and unchanged notification settings before confirmation
restoration.after_success: Record mechanical restoration result, return without project work; subsequent normal triggers use default caps
restoration.on_unconfirmed: No project work; report narrow scheduler dependency, do not create another automation

weekly_evidence_audit.maintenance_scope: All canonical page types; schema coverage is not atomic evidence completeness or fact renewal
weekly_evidence_audit.stable_gate: Read-only reviewer PASS for full-inventory repeat/model parity/denial controls and noise-aware queue; weekly triage still requires source/claim reconciliation, never automatic fact renewal

release_policy: Follow the existing independent-review, exact-path, QA, direct-main, deployment, and production-verification gates in AGENTS.md.

local_dependencies.name: semrush
local_dependencies.fallback: Use the latest normalized import, label freshness, and continue when Semrush is not required evidence.
